def: ignition, i.e. (specially), smelting (figuratively, conflagration, calamity as a test)

occurrences.text: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:
And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What city is like unto this great city!
